description: An android version of the forge build site: a native Android client for the ForgeBuild dashboard — browse apps in apps/, view per-app releases/APK downloads, BUILD_STATE.json and PROMPT_HISTORY, and generate type-1 new-app contract prompts, all against the GitHub API of vjumbo264/forgebuild.

tasks.title: Choose slug (forge-android), create apps/forge-android/ as a copy of engine/, seed BUILD_STATE.json + PROMPT_HISTORY/forge-android.md, commit+push as push-access proof.
tasks.notes: Slug forge-android chosen by building AI (no collision in apps/: calcom, clipforge-android, forgehouse50, tapcounter, theme-showcase). engine/ copied verbatim as starting point. Slug recorded as FIRST field of this file and is permanent: folder apps/forge-android/, tags forge-android-vN, PROMPT_HISTORY/forge-android.md.

tasks.title: Set identity: namespace/applicationId com.forgebuild.forgeandroid in app/build.gradle.kts, app_name in res/values/strings.xml, move MainActivity to matching package.
tasks.notes: namespace/applicationId set to com.forgebuild.forgeandroid; app_name "ForgeBuild"; MainActivity moved to com/forgebuild/forgeandroid/ with package updated. Manifest references .MainActivity (resolves via namespace).

tasks.title: Adaptive icon via tools/make_adaptive_icon.py with created foreground artwork.
tasks.notes: Created simple hammer foreground artwork (tools/icon_fg.png, transparent, white silhouette), ran tools/make_adaptive_icon.py --background-color #6750A4 --out app/src/main/res: foreground scaled into the 72dp safe zone, solid background, monochrome layer for themed icons; mipmap densities mdpi-xxxhdpi generated; existing anydpi-v26 XML now points at the generated layers.

tasks.title: Confirm repo-level signing secrets exist (KEYSTORE_BASE64, KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, KEY_ALIAS, KEY_PASSWORD) via GitHub API; do not regenerate.
tasks.notes: Verified via GitHub API actions/secrets: KEYSTORE_BASE64, KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, KEY_ALIAS, KEY_PASSWORD all present on vjumbo264/forgebuild. Not regenerated.

tasks.title: Implement the app (one feature per commit): GitHub API data layer + INTERNET permission; apps list screen (cache-first); app detail screen (releases/APK/build state/prompt history); type-1 new-app prompt generator screen; navigation + M3 Expressive polish.
tasks.notes: App implemented: GitHub REST client (platform HttpURLConnection + org.json — zero new dependencies) + PatStore; AppsRepository/DetailRepository on Engine CacheFirstStore (instant cached render, background reconcile, non-blocking refresh affordance); INTERNET permission declared (only permission the app uses); 3 screens (apps list, app detail with releases/build-state/prompt-history tabs, type-1 new-app prompt generator) + single-activity navigation; all UI inside ForgeBuildTheme with EngineIcons, SpacingTokens, MaterialTheme shapes/typography/colorScheme, PrimaryTabRow, expressive EngineLoadingIndicator. No emoji, no hardcoded colors, no substitutions.

tasks.title: Validate build configuration, dispatch release.yml with app_path=apps/forge-android, verify forge-android-v1 release + APK asset via GitHub Releases API.
tasks.notes: Build config validated (namespace/applicationId com.forgebuild.forgeandroid, R8+shrinkResources on, INTERNET only permission, adaptive-icon mipmaps present). Release attempt 1 (run 35417234142) failed at compileReleaseKotlin due to an Engine-level defect (engine/ EngineExpressive.kt referenced material3 SplitButton/overflowIndicator APIs absent from pinned 1.5.0-alpha28); fixed engine-level by replacing with the CI-verified expressive component source from apps/forgehouse50 (package adjusted), propagated into this app. Release attempt 2 (run 35417484567) completed success.

tasks.title: Set build_complete: true only after forge-android-v1 verified live.
tasks.notes: forge-android-v1 VERIFIED LIVE via the GitHub Releases API on vjumbo264/forgebuild (published 2026-09-19T03:06:13Z, draft=false): app-forge-android-v1.apk (1,413,531 bytes, HTTP 200 download) + forgebuild-manifest.json. Signed APK built by release.yml from apps/forge-android. build_complete set true.
